name: Minority hearts 6 ~Saimin Netorare~
source:
Marta, Colette and party from Tales of Symphonia: Knight of Ratatoski are spelled with hypnosis/confusion, and are addicted to fleshly sins.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE100852.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
《仙乐传说：骑士拉塔托斯克》的玛尔塔、柯蕾特与同伴被催眠、扰乱心智，沉溺于肉体罪恶。

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE100852.html]DLsite English[/url]]
